bitcoin_articles.headline: Strive Maintains Bitcoin Treasury Position Amid Market Downturn
bitcoin_articles.summary: Strive, Inc. reported that it has maintained its existing Bitcoin holdings of 43,404 BTC rather than initiating new purchases during the recent market decline.

bitcoin_articles.headline: American Bitcoin Corp. Secures $150 Million Credit Facility with FalconX
bitcoin_articles.summary: American Bitcoin Corp. has entered into a $150 million committed revolving credit facility with FalconX, secured by a portion of its Bitcoin holdings.

bitcoin_articles.headline: American Bitcoin Corp. Secures $150 Million Credit Facility with FalconX
bitcoin_articles.summary: American Bitcoin Corp., a majority-owned subsidiary of Hut 8 Corp., has entered into a $150 million revolving credit facility with FalconX to support its strategic growth and Bitcoin accumulation initiatives.

bitcoin_articles.headline: HashKey Exchange Appointed Sub-Custodian for GaoTeng Bitcoin ETF
bitcoin_articles.summary: HashKey Exchange has been selected to serve as the sub-custodian for the GaoTeng Global Asset Management Limited Bitcoin ETF, which recently began trading on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange.
